install.hint: Official methods vary by platform (Homebrew on macOS and Linux, Scoop on Windows, distro packages from GitHub Releases, npm as a per-project dev dependency); follow the docs page for yours. Only Homebrew is automated here. Not verified against a real machine: see project/documentation/supabase-connect-research.md.

auth.instructions: Run `supabase login` yourself in a terminal (add `--no-browser` on a headless machine). Open the URL or enter the code it prints, approve the sign-in in your browser, then tell me when you are done. Afterwards, approve the supabase MCP server in Claude Code and complete its own browser sign-in; that is a separate consent from the CLI login.
